New tunnel and viaduct enhance Kashmir Valley's all-weather connectivity

A new tunnel and viaduct, costing Rs 680 crore, have been completed on National Highway 44, significantly improving all-weather connectivity to the Kashmir Valley. The Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor expressed gratitude to Prime Minister Modi and Union Minister Nitin Gadkari for the project. This infrastructure development aims to ensure smoother and more reliable access to the region.
